import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_sublevel_iff_centered_margin (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 ↔ 0 ≤ 81 - (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 := by
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : 0 ≤ 81 - (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 5 / 2)]
    exact h₁
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 5 / 2)]
    exact h₁

theorem quadratic_sublevel_iff_centered_margin (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10 ↔ 0 ≤ 81 - (2 * x - 5) ^ 2 := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [hident]
    nlinarith
  · intro h
    rw [hident] at h
    nlinarith
